3.text: A cockroach’s egg case can become another insect’s nursery. And the cockroach eggs are on the menu.
3.payoff: Reveal that the other insect is an ensign wasp: the female lays an egg inside the cockroach egg case, and the developing larva feeds on the roach eggs.

4.text: A cockroach’s egg case can have an extra egg inside. It belongs to a completely different insect.
4.payoff: Identify the extra egg as an ensign wasp egg and explain how its larva feeds on the cockroach eggs around it.
